answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 54244 Country: India Title: Construction Masjid Toilet Question: Can I use interest money for the construction of Masjid's toilet? Answer ID: 54244 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1522/1255/B=10/1435) No, you cannot. Interest money should be given to poor and needy ones without the intention of reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
